metadata.sceneryMethod: OSM water/coast/beach/waterway or green boundary within 150m of edge midpoint, water priority; otherwise road-class city/unknown. Approximation, not measured view or tree cover.
metadata.accessMethod: OSM allowed highway tags; explicit pedestrian/access restrictions, motorroad, lifecycle ways and cycle-only ways excluded. Missing tags remain unknown. No field inspection, live closures, slope or lighting validation.
metadata.poiMethod: Original point or actual boundary vertex nearest largest graph component, max 100m geodesic gap. Not a verified entrance or traversable connector. Closed businesses may remain in OSM.
metadata.crossingMethod: Node highway=crossing or non-no crossing tag. Missing crossings are unknown, not zero ground-truth crossings.
